lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 to 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is non-uniform: the first three anterior lines are closely spaced, followed by wider intervals in the mid-torso, and compressed spacing in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A vertical split (bifurcation) is visible at the ventral terminus of the fourth line from the shoulder; lines 5 and 6 converge toward each other at their lower boundaries.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 terminates at the mid-shoulder level; lines 9, 10, and 11 appear as fragmented, dashed segments that do not span the full vertical depth of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5-6 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned between the mid-thigh and the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch align horizontally; three smaller spots form a diagonal alignment near the base of the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron-shaped spot on the bridge of the muzzle; distinct white spots on the lower limbs; white patch on the ventral throat area; white spot posterior to the ocular orbit.
